services.value: Eurofins Environment Testing provides environmental testing and analytical services including air and vapor, built environment testing, ground and surface water, industrial hygiene, metals and metals speciation, microplastics, municipal and drinking water, PFAS testing, sediment and tissue, soil and hazardous waste, and specialty services. For the waste management sector it also offers groundwater and leachate monitoring, landfill gas monitoring, ambient air monitoring, waste characterization, and RCRA characteristic testing (ignitability, corrosivity, reactivity and toxicity), including TCLP, SPLP and CA WET methods.
